note: enabled is the only switch of the Release workflow (changesets.yml); the off-master path is the SHA-bound courier-stable-stage.yml route (raw-publish.yml and manual-release.yml were retired, TC-4123). packages is the release scope. baselines is a go-time input: the newest stable version npm has for each package, equal to its manifest version; re-baseline both together whenever something is published from another commit (the Courier route, a TC-4082 patch). expect optionally locks the exact versions of the next release. A successful release rewrites baselines and clears expect. See docs/versioning.md.
